title: Unveiling Key Gene Signatures in Pancreatic Cancer: Advanced Computational Insights for Biomarker and Therapeutic Target Discovery.
snippet: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) remains the most lethal type of pancreatic cancer, with a dismal 11% 5-year survival rate, owing to its rapid progression and metastasis. title: The Intratumoural CCR7+ Dendritic Cell Pool Includes Cells of Potential Monocyte Origin and Is Expanded by FLT3L-Ig Treatment.

title: Circulating Tumour DNA-Guided Adjuvant Therapy Following Radical Cystectomy for Muscle-Invasive Bladder Cancer: A Narrative Review.
snippet: Despite radical cystectomy and advances in perioperative treatment, patients with muscle-invasive bladder cancer remain at risk of recurrence.
